title: System Breaker
tagline: He didn't get a system. He found its source code.
author: L.C.

protagonist.name: Chen Lin
protagonist.background: Former full-stack developer, died from overwork, transmigrated into a fantasy game world
protagonist.goal: Find the 'Admin' who runs this world and get back home

system.name: N.E.X.U.S (Networked EXecution Unit System)
system.personality: Deadpan, sarcastic, treats Chen like a buggy user
quirks: Replies to complaints with log files
Has 'TODO' comments in its own code
system.core_ability: Debug Mode — view and modify the underlying 'code' of spells, items, and NPCs

world.name: Aethoria
world.setting: Medieval fantasy with magic that works like compiled code
factions: The Guild Assembly — official adventurer's guild, bureaucratic and corrupt
The Null Sect — a cult that worships the 'void' (runtime errors)
The Order of Compilers — ancient scholars who write new spells
world.current_arc: Chen wakes up in a goblin dungeon at level 1 with nothing but a rusty dagger and a system that talks back.

story_threads: Who or what is the Admin?
Why does the system have bugs?
Is Aethoria a game or something else?
